name: Strawberry with condensed milk
summary: Fresh Da Lat strawberries under sweet condensed milk, in a cup or a bag, to eat as you walk the market.
origin: A market snack in Da Lat, made with the strawberries the farms grow.
howToEat: Order a cup or a bag in the daytime at Da Lat Market.
Wash the fruit if you are cautious.
where: Da Lat Market, on the slope above Xuan Huong Lake.
